recording.source: Same-binary redeployment and hot restart with MIDI worker enabled; normal UI/DSP, JUCE8.0.15, actual MAYA48k/512, zero app inputs/four outputs. iPad serious thermal2 at startup, no thermal override. User reported absent WRLD.BLDR LED output before restart; post-restart physical LED verification pending.
recording.timing_note: Window local and epoch boundaries are derived from the same ISO timestamps at microsecond precision. End is nominal recorder start plus exact WAVE data-frame duration. Original separately sampled wrapper epoch timestamps and completion time are retained in wrapper_* fields and the raw recorder JSON. Independent audio clocks/start latency mean this is not sample-accurate device-log alignment.

callbacks.limit: dsp_us measures the instrumented processing region; it excludes subsequent callback logging and outer JUCE/native work. xr is the native device counter.

correlation.correlation_limit: Wave event matching uses a conservative 750 ms neighborhood and reports unique callback/wave episodes. Multiple USB failure messages can belong to one interruption. Recorder/CoreAudio startup latency and independent audio clocks shift WAV timing relative to app logs; offsets are not causal transport latency measurements.

midi.time_selection: App wall-clock seconds within nominal recording interval; edge observations may differ by less than one second. Counters/depth are independently sampled. Submissions are handler calls, not hardware acknowledgments; depth is approximate.

periodic.method: Consecutive 1-second bins with at least 10 short flat candidates form dense episodes. Same criterion as the earlier UI comparison. Natural quiet/smooth music can produce candidates; inspect waveform and cadence to attribute periodic blanking. Analog settling affects widths. No claim against subtle clicks.

startup_limit: Two matching MAYA transaction errors/restarts and217–219ms callback gaps at11–13seconds after playback began, thermal2. Occurred during startup verification before K-Mix recording; no analog coverage there. First callback also had17.296ms DSP time and470frames, a separate startup event.
physical_midi_output: User confirmed LEDs work in this build after redeployment; confirmation received during analysis. Does not retrospectively establish physical MIDI delivery throughout preceding15:08 session.
waveform_inspection: Three isolated0.417–0.500ms low-variation candidates have smooth transitions and nonzero channel offsets; no abrupt zero-filled block or dense cadence established. Not evidence of prior sustained periodic blanking, and subtle clicks are not excluded.
outcome: No long analog interruption, native callback stall, USB transaction failure/restart, drift report or dense periodic episode in the measured960seconds. Two early USB/callback failures before recording show serious thermal does not prevent all failures.
